ABOUT THE ARTIST / 김뜻돌

Meaningful Stone

Meaningful Stone (김뜻돌) writes songs from remembered dreams and personal relationships. In a Genie interview, she described wanting to record the atmosphere that lingered between dreams and waking life.

She debuted in 2017 with the single 꿈속의 카메라 and released her first full-length album, A Call from My Dream, in 2020. She won Rookie of the Year at the 2021 Korean Music Awards.
